attributes.board_name: Missouri State Board of Registration for the Healing Arts

rules.accepted_credit_types: AOA Category 1-A or 2-A; AMA Category 1; American Academy of Family Practice Prescribed Credit. Alternative: 40 hours, all AOA Category 1-A or AMA Category 1, each activity with a post-test.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CME in the renewal period of initial Missouri licensure if the licensee never held a permanent license in Missouri or another US state.
rules.alternatives: American Specialty Board certification or recertification during the reporting period; AMA/AOA-approved internship or residency, or an advanced-training fellowship, of at least 60 days in the period. Extension (written request before Dec 31, $50 fee) for illness or hardship; military extension/exemption; retired physicians with affidavit waived.
rules.audit_note: Attest under penalty of perjury on the renewal form; keep records (titles, dates, locations, sponsors, category, hours) for 3 years after the reporting period; the board may audit.
rules.notes: Reporting period runs Jan 1 of each even year to Dec 31 of each odd year. From the rule effective June 30, 2026: at least 1 of the 50 hours on the health benefits of nutrition (no topic code). Limited license: 10 hours per period.
